name.full: Learn Path Adviser for Microsoft Copilot Cowork

description.short: Analyzes Word, PDF, text, PowerPoint and Excel files and produces one combined summary.
description.full: Learn Path Adviser reads a set of files in Word (.docx), PDF (.pdf), plain text (.txt), PowerPoint (.pptx) and Excel (.xlsx/.xls) formats, extracts their content, and produces a single consolidated summary covering all analyzed files together - including cross-file themes and a suggested learning path - instead of one summary per file.
